beats.text: Carl and Donut go on Odette's show expecting her to raise it. She talks instead about D'Nadia trying to have their team legislated out of the planning meetings, and she never once mentions the post.

beats.headline: One post keeps it either way
beats.text: Whatever the vote does to the sponsors, the adjutants keep their coverage. It is a good part of what makes the post attractive to somebody famous who fancies a season on a battlefield.

beats.headline: Three names, and a baroness
beats.text: Odette announces that she is sponsoring a deity this season instead. She offers three candidates for the team's post, and Carl picks Baroness Victory.

beats.headline: Three candidates, and the crawler picks the lawyer
beats.text: Odette puts three of us in front of the crawlers on her show, having first announced that she is sponsoring a deity of her own this season, Nekhebit, which is her affair. What the crawlers are choosing is an adjutant for the ninth floor. Carl picks me. He does not ask what I did for a living before this, which is just as well, because the answer is tax work, and the answer after that is that I did it to my own relatives.

beats.headline: Odette announces her sponsorship
beats.text: On her own show, in front of the audience she built, Crawler Odette announces that she is sponsoring a deity this season, and the deity is Nekhebit. Then she offers three choices of adjutant and Crawler Carl takes Baroness Victory. Everybody in the room is watching the adjutant question. I would gently suggest that the first sentence was the news.

beats.headline: What the crossbow says about her
beats.text: The lore attached to a repeating crossbow, for anyone who reads the flavour text: the long-forgotten goddess Nekhebit is jealous and terrible. When the elf mothers abandoned her to worship Apito, the Oak Goddess, Nekhebit grew enraged, blamed the male-dominated high elf court for letting her worshippers stray, and cursed their seed. Every elf and fairy breed in the universe traces back to that court and that curse. It is called the Fae Diaspora. Somebody put all of that on a weapon description and expected nobody to read it.

beats.headline: One of the names on the adjutant list
beats.text: There is a list going round with my name on it. Crawlers choosing an adjutant for the coming floor, and somebody has put the host of a panel show on the shortlist, which means either that they have excellent taste or that they are not taking this remotely seriously. Either way, folks. I am flattered.

beats.headline: Her price is the truth
beats.text: Carl asks why I am helping, which is the correct question and the only one I respect, so he gets the whole answer. Mordecai's brother Uzzi is dead because I would not pay Huanxin Jinx what she asked, and the guilt of that is the engine under everything I have done since. Then the larger thing, which nobody says aloud: every world they run a crawl on is being burned for fuel. That is the business. I mean to shut it down, to do it responsibly, and to be the one who does it. Never trust anyone until you know what they are getting out of it. Now he knows.

beats.headline: The agreement stands
beats.text: The adjutant arrangement did not happen the way I laid it out. Odette is not the one in the chair. I find Carl in Florida and tell him plainly that this changes nothing on my side: what I said I would do, I am doing. He is waiting for the second half of the sentence, the part where I revise the price. There is no second half. Gods trade down here, and I am aware that this is what he thinks he is standing in. He is wrong, and I am not going to argue about it.

beats.headline: Half of Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang
beats.text: The card gets played. Asojano and Uzi Jesus combine into a single totem, Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, which is either the best or the worst thing to happen to a former god of disease. I have decided not to rule on which.

beats.headline: Out of a Gold Prepotente Box
beats.text: Donut has just told Carl she is frightened and does not want to be in charge. Carl opens a Gold Prepotente Box and finds a book he cannot trade, cannot destroy and cannot throw away. Drop it and it is back in his inventory. It is named for the pin boards at old conventions, and the System goes out of its way to say that this is the only reason.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it the man looks away from the hydra and into my eye, my magic eye, and I do a small thing to him while he is looking. What it does is my business.

beats.headline: Primal Engines, on the recap
beats.text: Orren takes the recap episode and explains what a Primal Engine is and what a Macro AI is. He states plainly that this one has gone rogue, and assures the audience he has negotiated a settlement with it. Every team holding a slot in the next game tries to abdicate it the same day.

beats.headline: Everyone associated with the group is gone
beats.text: A flyer reaches Carl telling him to go to a shelter, and his liaison warns him the box carrying it was sent days ago and seized on the way. Everyone connected to that group has disappeared. I am one of the people on that list. Do not come looking; it is not the kind of disappearance you can walk into and reverse.

beats.headline: The Residuals
beats.text: Paulie at the shelter has been giving the same speech every day of his existence, against the chance that the crawl would one day use a memory for a floor. He is a Residual. There are a great many of him, on every world that holds a Primal Engine, and what they are for is saying a particular thing to the system AI.

beats.headline: He never went to the healer
beats.text: A look back at that visit shows the healer never saw him. Whatever Carl was doing inside the club while Pater Coal talked, he has kept it to himself.

beats.headline: Failed, and something worse announced
beats.text: Samantha scouts ahead and finds Sister Ines on a giant snake, ringed by charmed crabs and seals with nothing behind their eyes. The quest fails. Hell Comes to Crawler Town is announced in its place, and the sheer count of corpses on the floor props a door open onto Sheol.

beats.headline: The Demon Eviction opens the door
beats.text: Enough crawlers and NPCs die on the eighth floor at once that the dungeon declares a Demon Eviction, and the eviction runs in one direction: out of Sheol and onto the floor, looking for bodies to inhabit. The realm has been adjacent this whole time, waiting on a body count.

beats.headline: Ren's exit
beats.text: The plan runs on teleport traps, two keys, and Samantha arriving somewhere she cannot walk to. Quan Ch surfaces at Ren's exit. Carl throws her the length of the map with the scoop, then teleports in behind her.

beats.headline: Announced in an area message
beats.text: The Madre de Aguas is dead. That is the first thing the area message says. The second is that she has risen as a zombie, and the third, in the very same breath, is my name: the major demon Amayon, demon prince of Sheol, come into this realm to possess her. I could not have written the announcement better myself. Everyone in range heard it. Good. A prince should not have to introduce himself.

beats.headline: She will not let them leave
beats.text: I message the man's party. They are heading for Imani's exit, in the church. I tell them the truth: I cannot let them go into that exit. I can save them, if they come to me. Imani will tell them the church is being overrun by demons, and that the demons are mine. That is also the truth. Both things are true. I did not make this floor. I am only deciding what to do on it.

beats.headline: It is not local
beats.text: Crawlers everywhere report their exits taking damage and becoming unusable. Amayon fights Sister Ines' control and works on a spell to get home.

beats.headline: Amayon fights her control
beats.text: I hold Amayon, prince of Sheol, in the body of a giant snake, and he pulls against me. He is trying to cast; he wants to go home. I do not let go. Around us every exit on this floor is failing at once, and the Demon Eviction is worldwide. This is what I have to set against that. A demon on a leash and my own two hands. God did not give me more.

beats.headline: At the church with the rest
beats.text: The church, and it is full. Imani is there, and then Katia's people, and then Li Na's, and then mine. My own squad. Every one of us got here on a Doggy Door upgrade that Lucia handed round before she took the stairs down. I do not know what that girl is. She gave us a way through, and I am standing in a church with my friends because of it, so I will say thank you and keep the rest of my opinions where they belong.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.

beats.headline: Lucia hands out Doggy Doors
beats.text: Tier 3 upgrades, given round before she went down the stairs, are how Katia, Elle, Imani and Li Na's squads all reach the church on the eighth floor.

beats.headline: A name a demon brings up
beats.text: Amayon mentions Ysalte, in passing, the way a prisoner mentions the guard he does not want to talk about. Mordecai supplies the file: she is often sponsored by the Nebular team, and if she were in this realm, we would know about it. That is a reasonable position, well argued, and consistent with everything on record. I want it in writing that he said it.

beats.headline: Filed as Pox Slugs, and unbothered by it
beats.text: The System first registers them as Pox Slugs, which is accurate and entirely misses the point. They come out of the boils of the SlugPox, they arrive with a crude and rowdy culture already assembled, and they throw themselves at the court’s enemies with the enthusiasm of people who cannot believe their luck at being included.

beats.headline: Her nun goes down, and she arrives
beats.text: Thirty-second floor of the FOCSA building. Crawler Carl puts Sister Ines out with the Nighty-Night wand and Crawler Louis finishes the job. Sister Ines had a patron, and her patron is Ysalte, and Ysalte comes into the realm about it in a temper that registers on my instruments. Crawler Louis is marked for death. So much for nobody being able to arrive without us knowing.

beats.headline: Nobody is driving
beats.text: The readout on this one is worse than the goddess. She is sponsored, but the sponsor is not inhabiting her, which means she speaks and acts as herself with nothing between her and the room. She is invulnerable. She takes hold of Amayon while the building comes down around him, and when a teleport trap shakes him loose of the snake body it does not shake him loose of her. The Missing Piece quest opens on the back of it: free the demon, get him casting, and survive her totems for the ten minutes before she is back. She cannot be killed. That is not encouragement, it is a specification.

beats.headline: Its fire, released by a benefit
beats.text: Carl takes acid damage until his health drops to five percent, which triggers his Martyr's Path benefit, which releases Sheol fire everywhere he has stepped outside. The realm's fire is a resource now, one a crawler can spend without ever having gone there.

beats.headline: Put down by one of her own totems
beats.text: Goddess of Hopelessness and Insanity Ysalte has been removed from this realm by a totem raised from the former crawler Paz. Her own quest furniture, turned around and used on her. The Missing Piece completes. Elsewhere in the same collapse Crawler Carl rides his health down to five percent on purpose to set fire to every street he had walked on, which tells you what kind of afternoon this was for everybody.

beats.headline: A timer on a global teleport
beats.text: Their quest, the Missing Piece, updates. Succeeded, it says. And beneath the word, a timer, one for each region, counting down to the moment my spell goes off there. A global teleport. When it lands, the walls of their stairwell chambers will be sucked away, and anyone crouched beneath them pulled upward into the stairwell. They wanted me casting. They have their wish. Home is the direction I am going in any case, and I have never minded company on the road.

beats.headline: The audience decides
beats.text: About to be pulled into a stairwell and out of contact, Carl and Donut spend an emergency action item to hand every unresolved vote to the viewers. The viewers strip the safety protections from the faction sponsors, seat the tenth team, loosen the physics on long-range artillery, raise the ceiling over the field and widen it to hold an unprecedented number of surviving crawlers.

beats.headline: Voted away
beats.text: The viewers take the safety protections off the faction sponsors. Every one of them who sets foot on the ninth floor now stands to lose exactly what the crawlers stand to lose.

beats.headline: He takes command of one of nine armies
beats.text: Thirty days. A castle at Larracos, dead centre of the map. No coming back from a death on this floor, for anyone. Supply, alliances, atrocity, at a scale where the arithmetic stops being about people I know.

beats.headline: Due before anyone descends
beats.text: The Sultanate holds the ninth floor, and the stairs to the tenth stay shut until the Sultan and his family are dead.

beats.headline: The Sultanate is on this floor
beats.text: The stairs to the tenth do not open for a royal who has not killed the Sultan and the rest of the family.

beats.headline: The rules, read out on arrival
beats.text: Ten teams. Nine attacking, spread around the city like slices of a pie, and the NPCs defending it from inside. Take the castle at the centre. Sixty hours of ceasefire first, in which a crawler may enlist with any army that will have them or run for the woods, and after which anyone still loose can be compelled into a uniform. Two hundred and ninety-three stairwell chambers sit seeded across the floor, and not one opens until Faction Wars is won or thirty hours remain on the clock.

beats.headline: The crawl arrives inside it
beats.text: Crawlers come down into Larracos at the start of a sixty-hour ceasefire. The armies that have spent eight floors drilling and drinking are allowed to fight one another at last, and the thing they are fighting over is underfoot: the castle at the bottom of the well.

beats.headline: Thirty days, nine armies, one castle
beats.text: Roughly 32,000 conscripted crawlers and 50,000 retired ones against something near 100,000 armed enemies, fighting over Larracos at the centre of the map. Nothing that dies here comes back.

beats.headline: The crown comes due
beats.text: The Blood Sultanate is on this floor, and every royal in the line must slay the Sultan and all the other members of the royal family before descending to the tenth. I am a royal in the line. I have been since the first floor. I would like it noted that I was told to read the description.

beats.headline: The defending team names itself
beats.text: Carl and Donut come onto the ninth floor at Larracos, at the start of a sixty-hour ceasefire, and the defending side already has a name it chose for itself. Cascadia runs through the rules. The crawlers ally with it against the Bloc, which is every other faction on the board.

beats.headline: They buy a storyline instead of fighting for one
beats.text: Quasar has the warning ready before the sixty-hour ceasefire is out. The Dream have bought out the Vengeance of the Daughter and are pressing for fulfilment of the guaranteed third season written into it. An entertainment holding, aimed at a crawler, on a floor where the weapons are supposed to be swords.

beats.headline: Sold, with a season still owed
beats.text: Quasar warns Carl on arrival that the Dream has bought the programme out and intends to collect on the guaranteed third season.

beats.headline: Donut wears his cloak
beats.text: Inventory update, ninth floor. Crawler Princess Donut opens a celestial box from Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions and takes out the Tiara of a Thousand Lights. In the same sitting she puts on Quan Ch's cloak and takes the benefits that come with it. The cloak does not ask where its previous owner is, and neither do I.

beats.headline: Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions
beats.text: Donut's celestial box from the sponsor holds it. She puts on Quan Ch's cloak in the same stretch and takes the benefits of both.

beats.headline: Hell-Kissed, Celestial, and the Prince of Woe
beats.text: A gold pet box, a patch that opens the Midnight Market, and the Hell-Kissed Celestial Skill Potion of the Prince of Woe. The potion hands Carl the Gloom Wraith Phase, which is a skill for walking through people.

beats.headline: Bred to be hit
beats.text: A pet-class mob, and by reputation an excellent melee tank, which in practice means the thing is designed to be the part of a party that absorbs damage on everyone else’s behalf. The System’s notice for one that has not yet bonded to a crawler is written like a card on a cage.

beats.headline: The reward for having survived being condemned
beats.text: It comes out of a celestial box, which is the dungeon’s way of paying a debt it would rather not discuss: the box is owed for surviving a death sentence handed down on the floor before. Louis takes delivery of an aircraft and a rank at the same moment, and neither of them was asked for.

beats.headline: Larracos: water, charges and sharks
beats.text: The plan had been to open onto the Skull Empire army and put a feral god in the middle of it — the exact outcome the lawsuit was meant to prevent. He changes it at the last moment, keeps the artifact rather than spending it, and floods the faction market instead: ocean water, timed explosives and a frenzy of sharks, cutting the factions off from resupply. Juice Box goes through with the water.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: I went through the Gate with the water. I lay low with the ones who lived through it, and when they were ready I told them. What they are. What this whole place is. Enough of them believed me that they call me Warlord now, and a Warlord has people, and a Warlord has opinions about alliances. I have sent War Leader Arief to Carl's people with my terms. The terms are Louis. He marries me. That is the alliance.

beats.headline: Juice Box tells them
beats.text: Under cover of the Larracos flood she hides among the survivors and spreads word of what they are.

beats.headline: Arief's tour
beats.text: War Leader Arief walks the group down through a city pumped out to its bottom three levels, with water still standing high enough to cover the castle. Juice Box has been waking its NPCs to the truth of what they are, and the college on level fifty is teaching again.

beats.headline: Ferdinand holds the interface
beats.text: Juice Box and Louis are reunited, and he is visibly uneasy about the marriage. Then she lays out the practical problem: Ferdinand is mayor of Shanty Town, just outside Larracos, and he holds the warlord interface for the team, because he is technically from outside. Nothing this side of the wall moves without a cat's cooperation. Drick is the adjutant.

beats.headline: Tipid fills him in
beats.text: He tells Carl about Doctor Hu and the Crawler Project at the Princess Posse HQ.

beats.headline: In the Princess Posse
beats.text: Carl and Donut walk into the HQ, and Carl stops. Fifty thousand of us in here, and he has to look at every one. Rosetta. Tipid. Me. People who got out of a crawl once and know exactly what one is, and signed up for another anyway, under the banner of a cat. He gets emotional about it. Nobody gives him a hard time. We had the same faces on when we signed.

beats.headline: They are already there when he walks in
beats.text: Rosetta, Tipid, Justice Light and fifty thousand others have signed on. Carl gets emotional. Nobody has ever raised a force out of the show's own survivors before.

beats.headline: Doctor Hu, and the Crawler Project
beats.text: Carl needs the whole of it, so I give it to him in order. Doctor Hu. The Crawler Project. How fifty thousand of us came to be standing in this HQ under the Princess Posse's banner. None of it is anything he would ever have been told from inside; that is the thing about being retired, you learn what the ones still crawling are not shown. He listens. That is rarer than it sounds.

beats.headline: Digging in
beats.text: NPCs, mercenaries and former crawlers build the defences together, which is three categories of person the format keeps apart on purpose.

beats.headline: Blood bar rules are back
beats.text: The blood bar rules are back in force inside the safe rooms. I tell Carl now, while knowing it still costs nothing. Around us the NPCs, the mercenaries and the rest of us former crawlers are building the defences on the same line, three kinds of people this format has always kept apart, working shoulder to shoulder. I do not have a rule for that. I am watching it closely.

beats.headline: What one is actually for
beats.text: An elite walks into the team's flag room during the ceasefire, pressed into service as a bomb by a production company that wants Carl off the board. Baroness Victory puts her down before the satchels can go off. The office is classed as a non-combatant observer, which makes the moment a curiosity for the rule book as much as a rescue.

beats.headline: Herman the Fleet does not get to finish
beats.text: Carl, Donut, Tipid and Florin come into the Fortress of Unyielding Power and Authority, and Florin walks them through the ceasefire rules. Then an Elite by the name of Herman the Fleet, sent in by Sensation Entertainment, reveals what he actually is, which is a delivery system for a bomb. I deal with him. An adjutant may do that. It is in the rules, and I have read the rules.

beats.headline: Still pregnant, and family
beats.text: Kiwi is very pregnant and has been carrying since the Hunting Grounds, which is a long time to be in that condition even by this dungeon's standards. Big Tina, for her part, has decided that Mongo is her father. Nobody in the fortress has the standing, the courage, or frankly the desire to correct her.

beats.headline: Commander of the 103rd
beats.text: Subject is a former crawler whose season was Land War, and he comes to the Princess Posse’s aid during the faction fighting. He is given a battalion, the 103rd, on the strength of what he has done both inside a dungeon and outside one. He is recognised on sight by people who have never crawled. That is rarer than it sounds.

beats.headline: A gift for attending
beats.text: Subject is a Tummy Acher, a pet-class mob built to absorb damage, and he came to his crawler as a gift for attending CrawlCon. Tserendolgor took delivery of a party favour. What she has now is a tank that levels every time the group goes hunting, which is not what a party favour is for.

beats.headline: Carl wakes up in their base
beats.text: Eleven hours gone, blood all over him, and everyone in the room around him killed by the thing riding inside him. The Lemig Sortion and the Madness had been arranging something together. It has come apart on top of them.

beats.headline: The field ruling
beats.text: Carl, Commander Stockade, Architect Houston and their adjutants convene for an official adjudication, and it goes on the record. The Lemig Sortion and the Madness used outside information to time a Summon Ally, meaning to pull Carl bodily to their base so that what was in him could be let loose on the rest of the Princess Posse. They got half of him, and the other half of the plan.

beats.headline: A foul, and a ceasefire cut short
beats.text: Panford, the Lemig Sortion's adjutant, stands up and explains to the council what his own team did: an attempt to pull Carl bodily to their base while Mordecai was working to expel what rides inside him. The Sortion is penalised for cheating and the ceasefire is cut short.

beats.headline: Punished, and the ceasefire ends early
beats.text: Panford, their adjutant, is left to explain the rampage through the base to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye, lost his mind, and finished it himself. Ferdinand gets an emergency action item passed for a live feed blackout so nobody can do this again. The Lemig Sortion is punished for cheating, the ceasefire ends early, and Carl goes home.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.

beats.headline: The rampage through the Lemig base
beats.text: Stockade tries to pull Carl bodily to his position while Mordecai tries to force her out of him. What comes of it is hers, and the adjutant Panford is left explaining the wreckage.

beats.headline: In the southern push
beats.text: Carl and Donut join the defence in the south, and the Nagas are in the line of it beside the Dream and the Prism. Cobra-headed, and a Syndicate power in their own right, whatever the Blood Sultanate is used to calling them.

beats.headline: Dumplins with the Gurgles
beats.text: The southern defence is already holding against the Dream, the Prism and the Nagas when the Reavers make their contribution: a swarm of their pet Dumplins, infected. This is a power that fights by handing you something diseased and standing back.

beats.headline: Marked, and taken by the dinosaur
beats.text: Empress D'nadia of the Prism Kingdom, warlord of the Prism clan, is dead. Crawler Carl marked her with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Mongo did the rest. She said at the finish that everything she did she did for her people; he told her to her face that she did it for herself and that her people will pay for it. I am obliged to broadcast both halves of an exchange like that.

beats.headline: Carl gets the background on them
beats.text: Tina rampages, the compromised mages are put down, and somewhere in the middle of that Carl finally hears what a Reaver actually is. Several races who replaced themselves with machinery one piece at a time until only the brain was left organic. They wear plastic skin because they have chosen to.

beats.headline: The army arrives, and asks to talk
beats.text: My army comes onto the field in good order, the way it has come onto every field for as long as there has been a Skull Empire. The crawlers seal their safe room against us, because they have learned what that doggy door of theirs is worth to an enemy. Fine. Let them shut it. I did not bring an army all this way to go through a door. I request an official parlay with Crawler Carl and Princess Donut, in the correct form, in front of every camera pointed at this floor.

beats.headline: King Rust at the wall
beats.text: The enemy forces arrive and the Skull Empire army is at the front of them with the king himself leading it. The Posse shuts the saferoom against another run through the Doggy Door. Rust asks for an official parlay.

beats.headline: The rules of the parlay
beats.text: I walk Carl and Donut up to the parlay and give them the rules before we arrive, because a parlay is a contract with a shorter fuse than most. King Rust brings Deng Bao, a Grixist, as his adjutant. Donut notices before I do that King Rust is crying.

beats.headline: The cat sees it first
beats.text: Baroness Victory reads out the rules of a parlay and each of us stands where we are told to stand. Deng Bao is at my shoulder, a Grixist, as an adjutant ought to be. Carl and the cat come out under the bubble and look at me, and the cat has it before a single word is spoken. I am crying. I have been a king a very long time and I have never once done this in front of an enemy.

beats.headline: What his daughter has done
beats.text: My daughter Formidable has commandeered one of my warships. She has announced to the Syndicate, openly, that she intends to trip the Failsafe by hand to keep the rogue thing on this planet out of the center system. And she told them the rest of it while she was at it: that my empire has been manufacturing their security systems with our own doors left quietly in the back of them. So here it is. I ask a crawler to send my daughter a message on behalf of the people of Earth, and I offer to pull my forces off this floor in exchange. Carl takes the deal.

beats.headline: The parlay, and what his daughter told the Syndicate
beats.text: Rust explains it himself. Princess Formidable has commandeered one of his own warships and announced that she means to trip the Failsafe by hand. She has also told the Syndicate that the empire builds secret back doors into the security systems it sells. He asks Carl to send her a message on behalf of the people of Earth and trades a retreat for it. Rosetta shoots him as he walks away, and the army comes in regardless.

beats.headline: A ring, a retina, and a data pad
beats.text: The agreement is made and the king turns to walk back to his own army, and I am waiting where I have been waiting. Afterwards I use his ring and his eye on a data pad, because a dead king's credentials open doors that a living one would never open for us. Then the ground goes: dwarves have been tunnelling under all of this, and the three of us fall into their work.

beats.headline: Walking back to his own line
beats.text: King Rust of the Skull Empire is dead. The agreement was made and he turned to walk back to his own army, and Rosetta Thagra came out of where she had been waiting and took him, for reasons entirely her own and nothing whatever to do with the deal. His army attacked the instant he fell. His ring and his retina went onto a data pad in Rosetta's hands, Carl looted the body, and a parlay conducted in the correct form in front of every camera on the floor ended in the one way the rules had not covered.

beats.headline: Something else is pouring
beats.text: I am in an office at the club, which is not my bar, having a conversation about the Failsafe. It is off. It stays off. To settle the argument I bring the princess here so the room can look at her, and then I set her down on the surface of a planet. And I am upset with the one who tried to kill me, and I am going to keep being upset about it for a while yet. Gary would never have said any of that. Gary is at the bar. Gary is always at the bar.

beats.headline: The AI asks which side to take
beats.text: It wants advice from Orren and from Carl, and teleports Donut in as well, and it asks in a laboured metaphor about relationships: Agatha's branch of the Residuals, or the Apothecary. Donut tells it to stay out of the whole business until it knows whether the boyfriend in prison is good, bad, or has no choice in the matter.

beats.headline: What is left of the Bloc
beats.text: The Bone Clan and the Dream leave the alliance. That leaves the Blood Sultanate, the Madness and the Reavers holding it, and the Reavers are not the sort of partner anyone chose.

beats.headline: They walk out of the Bloc
beats.text: The Bone Clan goes with them. What is left of the alliance is the Blood Sultanate, the Madness and the Reavers, which is a smaller thing than it was that morning.

beats.headline: Coming apart at the warlord council
beats.text: I get through the official business. Mostly. The words are not arriving in the order I put them in, and every warlord on the call is watching me not arrange them. Princess Vinata uses my family out loud today, to unsettle a crawler, as though my family were a piece of set dressing she is permitted to move. I let her. There is nothing in what she says that I can dispute.

beats.headline: It is coming for you all
beats.text: Odette arrives to replace Chaco, Cascadia comes apart on air, and Carl spends an emergency action item to shut the communication loophole the other teams have been using. Then Juice Box turns into an Unwashed in front of the cameras and tells everyone watching that it is coming for them all.

beats.headline: A whisper at the warlord council
beats.text: I come and stand at the crawler's shoulder while the council goes on around us, and I put a small question to him quietly, so that he alone hears it. Cascadia's whole family is dead. How does he imagine he will manage when his own is? He gives me no answer at all. That is an answer.

beats.headline: A ruling about the goat
beats.text: Most of the Naga army is already dead and Prepotente did it, for what the Blood Hunter show did to Miriam Dom. Carl would like to work with him. My advice is a ruling rather than an opinion: he may not, not directly, not while Prepotente stands outside the Princess Posse. Bring the goat inside the team, or keep your distance from him.

beats.headline: Killed by the Blood Hunter show, and answered for
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom is dead, and has been since the sixth floor. Cause of death: a programme called Blood Hunter. Filed under entertainment. Update from the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.

beats.headline: Prepotente takes their army apart
beats.text: Elle brings the count back. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and one goat did it, as payment for what the Blood Hunter show did to Miriam Dom. Baroness Victory tells Carl he cannot work with him directly unless he signs on properly.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.

beats.headline: The airship at their castle
beats.text: Louis and Donut come at the Naga castle from the air. Elle and Imani go in on foot. Katia tells Carl that if this goes badly she wants him to have the flower, so that Donut at least reaches the next floor. Prepotente arrives to meet them.

beats.headline: Sense Movement, level fifteen
beats.text: Rosetta has a theory about how Vinata keeps getting into Club Vanquisher, and Edgar is the instrument that settles it. He senses the non-corporeal moving through the castle. He also picks up upward momentum coming off the ground, which is what it looks like from below when somebody nearby worships a god for the first time.

beats.headline: This season's recruitment target
beats.text: Princess Vinata and her guard keep disappearing from a battlefield and reappearing in Club Vanquisher, and the reason is a recruitment quest for one of the gods of light. Their usual target, Theia, has been sponsored out from under them by the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network. Which leaves Khepri. Rosetta works this out from past seasons, which is a polite way of saying the crawlers now know something the Naga think is private.

beats.headline: The door into Club Vanquisher
beats.text: The Sultanate's trick is older than this season of theirs. One of the warlord's guards worships a god of light; the god summons its worshipper to a temple inside Club Vanquisher; the warlord's party travels with her, out of a castle nobody has ever cracked. This season I take the worship myself, and my god is Khepri, the usual name on that list having been bought out by the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network. Rosetta has been reading old seasons, and she has the shape of it.

beats.headline: Breaking into a country club
beats.text: Vinata and her guard keep stepping out of a fight and into the club, where nothing can reach them. So Katia, Carl, Prepotente and Samantha go in behind a wire long enough to carry Li Na's aura with them, and Li Jun, Bautista and Zhang stand in the doorways to keep the path open.

beats.headline: Holding the doors at Club Vanquisher
beats.text: Katia, Carl, Prepotente and Samantha are going into Club Vanquisher, and they are dragging a wire behind them long enough to extend my sister's auras all the way inside. Somebody has to keep the path open behind them. That is Bautista, Zhang and me. Doors. We are holding doors. It is not glamorous, and it is exactly the job I would have asked for, and I am holding mine.

beats.headline: The one open door on the floor
beats.text: The portal to all the temples, and inside one of them, Vinata. Deity summoning is throttled on this floor by the rules of the war, with one exception nobody thought to close: a god may always appear in his own temple. So Khepri is home. Samantha opens the door, Carl and Katia Grim and Prepotente go through it, and an achievement arrives to inform them, with the timing I have come to expect from this place, that they have walked into a trap. Carl's Scavenger's Daughter patch reads the room and hands him ninety seconds of immortality for standing near this particular god.

beats.headline: The trap has two immortals inside it
beats.text: They come through the portal into Khepri's temple, the crawler and Katia and the goat, with Samantha opening the door for them. Standing this near a god hands out ninety seconds of immortality and it does not enquire whose side anybody is on. His patch gives him his ninety. Being what I am gives me mine.

beats.headline: The endless temple, and what is at the table
beats.text: Since the crawlers are frozen and I have thirty seconds, the file on this one. Khepri is humanoid apart from the head, where there is instead an entire beetle, wings and legs and a small head of its own. He does not talk. He chitters. His temple is listed as endless, which in practice is a room and a door and one long table carrying a never-ending feast of four hundred and thirty-three kinds of insect. He was a retainer of Khnum until Khnum mysteriously dropped dead a few days ago, so he has taken service under another deity to keep himself alive. The big players ignore him. When everything unfreezes he is going to go absolutely bugshit at every person in that room, quite possibly including his own worshipper.

beats.headline: Never broke at all
beats.text: Time freezes for the AI to announce the fight, and it uses the moment to tell everyone watching that outside the dungeon the Nagas had only been pretending to be poor. There were secret plans to seize the shipbuilding facilities. Then time restarts and the fight happens anyway.

beats.headline: A god says she has been corrupted
beats.text: Temple business. Deities are pouring out of a portal into Club Vanquisher, and one of them, Hellik, stops long enough to hand Crawler Carl a message for Emberus: he did not kill Emberus's son, everything Emberus believes about him is a lie, Apito has been corrupted, and Nekhebit is behind all of it. I log what a deity says in front of a crawler. I am not required to believe it. Note it, date it, move on.

beats.headline: A bomb in the temple
beats.text: Katia and Prepotente drink Black Nimbus potions to get themselves thrown out of the temple. Then Carl casts Run, Little Gunter, Run and drops a bomb in the middle of a members-only room, and walks out of it on immortality. Khepri goes backwards through the air. Vinata, immortal herself, is blown out alongside him.

beats.headline: He turns up in person
beats.text: The temple goes up, the portal starts letting gods through into Club Vanquisher, and Khepri comes out with the rest of them. Hellik banishes her on sight, in front of everyone. Then he turns to Carl with a message for his brother: he did not kill Emberus's son, everything Carl has been told about him is a lie, Apito has been corrupted, and Nekhebit is the hand behind all of it. He asks for an alliance. The quest to kill him is still open in Carl's log while he says it.

beats.headline: A bomb in his own house
beats.text: Katia Grim and Prepotente drink Black Nimbus and get themselves ejected from the temple, which leaves Carl alone with a spell and a bomb. Everything in the room dies except the immortal and the invulnerable: Khepri, blasted backwards through his own endless feast, and Vinata, who has the same immortality status Carl does. Khepri follows them out through the portal, and Hellik banishes him mid-stride. Being a god of light does not appear to buy much on this floor.

beats.headline: Named through a portal
beats.text: Hellik, holding a portal open with gods pouring out of it around him, uses the time he has to say four things to Crawler Carl. He did not kill Emberus's son. Everything Emberus believes about him is a lie. Apito has been corrupted. And Nekhebit, he believes, is behind all of it. A vulture goddess almost nobody down here had heard of two floors ago is now the name at the bottom of a divine accusation.

beats.headline: Ninety seconds each, and hers runs out first
beats.text: Warlord Vinata of the Blood Sultanate is dead. Crawler Carl set a bomb down inside the temple and stood in the middle of it, and everything in that room without a god's blessing went with the blast. Two of them had one. The crawler and the warlord came out through the doorway wrapped around each other, and while they were still on the ground his slugpox returned to him, and a slug reached her in the second her ninety were spent. The portal is open. There are gods walking out of it into Club Vanquisher.

beats.headline: The AI drops a hint
beats.text: Going through his boxes, Carl collects an achievement for using a borrowed skill through the ability tattoo. The System volunteers, unprompted, that there is a way to put the two together with the book, and then declines to say what it is.

beats.headline: Zhang's Cape of Odds
beats.text: A box opens and there is a cape in it with my own name written into the item. That happens to Carl. It does not happen to me. Zhang's Cape of Odds, and I have no idea yet what the odds are of. Carl hands Li Na a ring the same afternoon and does not look happy about it. I have stopped being surprised by what the audience decides to give us and started asking what it is for.

beats.headline: Rishi's offer
beats.text: Their prisoner explains the Great Consensus, and that Vinata held to it, and that Vinata's group meant to steal the Naga fleet and leave the central system for good. Then he offers a signed document: citizenship in Naga lands for every native of Earth, if the Nagas may settle the other planets in Earth's system. Carl marks him with the ring and kills him.

beats.headline: The Great Consensus, and a fleet
beats.text: They have me, so they may have the rest of it. The philosophy is called the Great Consensus, and Vinata was an adherent of it, and what her circle intended was to take the Naga fleet and quit the central system entirely. I did not walk into that temple beside my wife. I knew what was waiting inside it, and I knew that going in with her made me as dead as she is. So I stayed outside, and buried myself in the dirt, and here I am, with something to trade.

beats.headline: The offer, and the ring
beats.text: For the record: the prisoner offered Crawler Carl a signed instrument granting every native of Earth citizenship in Naga lands, in exchange for the Naga settling the other planets of Earth's system. A real document, and worth something. Crawler Carl marked him with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Then he killed him. Sultan Rishi the Usurper, first of his name of the Naga Uprising, is dead.

beats.headline: Second through the gate
beats.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons opens the Gate of the Feral Gods in Dream territory, which is a thing one does when the alternative is worse. Meatus comes through first. Harpocrates comes through behind him, because that is how the gate works: you get what you asked for and then you get whatever was standing near it. Two deities are now loose in a warzone that already has more armies in it than it has room for.

beats.headline: First through the gate
beats.text: Operation Ruin is written up in the cookbook, Princess Donut is installed in the Nest, and Crawler Elle McGibbons opens the Gate of the Feral Gods in Dream territory. What comes out first is Meatus. What comes out behind him is Harpocrates. Neither of them was requested by name, because that is not a thing the gate offers, and both of them are now on a floor with four armies on it.

beats.headline: The two of them go for each other
beats.text: Update on the two gods in the Dream territory: they are fighting each other. Not the crawlers, not the armies, each other, immediately and with feeling. Whatever the crawlers were hoping for when that gate opened, this is a better result than any of them had a right to. Elsewhere the dwarves set off a volcano in Reaver territory, because everyone on this floor has decided that scale is a substitute for a plan.

beats.headline: He picks the other god
beats.text: Meatus and Harpocrates start fighting each other. Of every direction those two could have chosen on arrival, the crawlers have drawn the one that costs them nothing, which after the fortnight this floor has had feels less like luck and more like an apology. In Reaver territory the dwarves set off a volcano, so the ledger balances.

beats.headline: It starts again on the ninth floor
beats.text: Eris is summoned into the Reaver fighting and an eviction begins with her.

beats.headline: Summoned, and a demon eviction starts
beats.text: Nobody said my name. The fighting in Reaver territory added up to it on its own, which is how I am usually called for, and so I come. The moment I set foot in the realm a demon eviction begins, the way weather begins. I did not do that. It is simply what happens when I am in a room. Now then. Let me see who is here, and what they think they are fighting for.

beats.headline: What they actually are
beats.text: Nobody makes a war mage. Resleeve a symbiote, a skeleton and a flesher, a dozen times or more, and the magic still in the body fuses with it and wakes up sapient. They carry hundreds of spells, they are notoriously cruel, and a showrunner who hires them almost never gets to recycle them. A group conscripted under Prince Stalwart pulls him apart with Pull spells, and Akuma announces that they are a side of their own.

beats.headline: Stalwart explodes and the Gate goes with them
beats.text: Carl and Samantha come out of the Party Planner into Reaver territory. Stalwart teleports to them, and Akuma is beside him. Then Stalwart explodes, and Akuma teleports out holding the Gate of the Feral Gods. The war mages conscripted under Stalwart are nobody's soldiers now. They are a faction, which the rules do not have a slot for.

beats.headline: A mercenary with a lance and a sock
beats.text: I present myself at the Madness headquarters alongside Katia, Imani, Splash Zone and Bigs the slugalette, and I bring with me the lance, which I have carried without a mount since the club came down, and Mr. Jefferson, who is a tube sock of nickels and a better conversationalist than most of this company. And on this day I am given a swamp yak taken off King Rust. Gonk. I am mounted again.

beats.headline: One of the dancers, under contract
beats.text: He arrives at the Madness headquarters with Katia, Imani, Dong Quixote and Bigs the slugalette, and joins Carl and Elle there. For the file: he came out of the Penis Parade with the rest of the dancers when the club came down, signed a mercenary contract, and has been in every fight since without once being the reason a plan failed. Water mage. Short. Reliable. There are crawlers I could not write that sentence about.

beats.headline: Out of the gate, chasing an AI
beats.text: Feral God Yarilo enters the realm and goes straight after Samantha, which is precisely what he was let out for: something enormous and single-minded, aimed at an AI who is fast enough to lead it wherever the crawlers want it to go. Meanwhile Katia Grim, Imani, Dong and a slugalette named Bigs join Carl and Elle at the Madness headquarters. Everyone has a job. Samantha's job is running.

beats.headline: A rainbow the size of a hill
beats.text: A memorial crystal forms when a god dies. There is one on this battlefield now, visible from most of the territory, shaped like a rainbow and impossible to miss, and the name inside it is Apito. The mother of all the gods, the one who set the examination nobody passes, is an object in a crawler's hands, and the crawler holding it is Osvaldo, who does not belong to any army out there. Every unit in sight has just turned to look.

beats.headline: A giant rainbow in the Madness territory
beats.text: Sighting, Madness territory: a giant rainbow, visible from a very long way off. The rainbow is Apito's memorial crystal, and the hands holding it are Osvaldo's. He is in none of the Faction Wars armies. I did not think that was possible either. The rainbow has just told the Madness army exactly where Crawler Carl's group is standing, and they are calling in Prepotente's forces for backup. Thank you, Osvaldo.

beats.headline: The Ceremony of Chaos
beats.text: I call the Ceremony of Chaos and the field stops. Every soldier, every mage, every screaming thing mid-scream, held exactly where it stood. Nearly every. The Viceroys are pouring their mind magic into Carl at the same moment, and something in him tips over into a sixteenth level of Mind Balance, and he stays standing in the middle of my stillness, blinking at me. I could be offended. Instead I gather everyone I did freeze into one great pile beside the Dream castle. A gift. Unwrap it carefully.

beats.headline: He pulls a goddess into the pile
beats.text: The pile of witnesses is frozen, conscious and invulnerable, which is a combination I would like on the record as not my idea. Princess Donut casts Rolling Battle Formation on the whole heap and starts it moving. Meatus reaches into it and drags Eris in with him. A goddess of discord, inside a rolling ball of frozen soldiers, on a battlefield. Somewhere the Party Planner is coming apart and Crawler Louis is falling into a castle, and it is still the second most interesting thing on this floor.

beats.headline: Into the Madness castle
beats.text: Carl and I go into the castle itself while the ball is drawn away from it, and inside we find crawlers who did not choose to be standing there, and we bring them out. In the surgical theatre at the back is Architect Houston, midway through joining himself to a changeling's body. Carl interrupts the procedure.

beats.headline: He marks the princess
beats.text: Harpocrates marks Crawler Princess Donut for death. Crawler Li Jun puts herself between the god and the cat, and does not walk away from it. Note for the record that a mark from a deity is not a threat, it is a scheduling entry, and this one now has a name in the margin that was not there this morning.

beats.headline: Sharing a command he did not ask for
beats.text: We hold the castle at Larracos. Six hours more and the floor is ours. That should be the whole of the announcement. Instead Baroness Victory reads out two names as warlords of the War Mage Rebellion, and only one of them is mine. Agatha. Co-warlord. I did not bring this rebellion this far to share its title, least of all with her, and I have not hidden what I think of that. I will hold the castle. I will not pretend to be pleased.

beats.headline: Two warlords for one rebellion
beats.text: The War Mage Rebellion holds the castle at Larracos, and six hours on the clock decides the floor. I read the adjudication out exactly as it is written: Akuma and Agatha, co-warlords, equal standing. One of those two is displeased and does not trouble to conceal it.

beats.headline: They conscript gods
beats.text: Hold the castle at Larracos for six hours and the floor is theirs. They trade the gate away at the Midnight Market for five Hell-Kissed Potions of Conscription and put Yarilo on the field beside them. The system hands the rebellion two co-warlords, and the two of them cannot stand each other.

beats.headline: Two co-warlords, and a god on a leash
beats.text: They hold the Larracos castle, and six hours of holding it takes the floor. Baroness Victory reads out two co-warlords, Akuma and Agatha, and only one of them is pleased about it. The Gate goes onto the Midnight Market and comes back as potions, and the potions conscript Yarilo. Fopsy, adjutant for the Dream, has a theory: that Agatha now thinks the AI is a danger to the Eulogist and wants the ascendency game over so it can be shut down.

beats.headline: Conscripted with potions
beats.text: The War Mage Rebellion has taken the Larracos castle and holds it for six hours to win, and they have gone shopping for reinforcements. They conscript Yarilo, paid for with potions they traded for the gate on the Midnight Market. Somewhere in that chain a god of lust became a line item. Fopsy has a theory about why Agatha is doing any of this, and I will let her explain it, because I have a god to move.

beats.headline: Conscripted
beats.text: Crawler Li Na conscripts Harpocrates. A god of silence, level 250, invulnerable on this floor, is now on a crawler's side of the board because a crawler had the paperwork to put him there. Two chapters of him rampaging across the territory, and the resolution is administrative. I would like it noted that I find this floor exhausting.

beats.headline: A tattoo for the cat
beats.text: Rosetta, Milk and Edgar come up into the tower to work on Princess Donut. She is getting a tattoo, and given who does the ink around here, a tattoo is not decoration. It is a thing that will get up off her and fight when she calls it.

beats.headline: Agatha walks off her post
beats.text: Warlord Agatha abandons the position without explaining herself to anyone, and full leadership of the rebellion falls to Akuma. He does not appear to mind.

beats.headline: Taken off the board by another god
beats.text: Feral God Yarilo has been removed from this floor by Harpocrates, acting under the direction of Crawler Li Na. He came through a gate, chased an AI the length of a warzone, changed sides for a crate of potions, and finished at the hands of the god who had come through that same gate ahead of him. Everything down here becomes somebody's equipment, the gods included.

beats.headline: A Pied Piper benefit, made permanent
beats.text: Crawler Carl picked up a Pied Piper benefit off Harpocrates, the way a crawler picks up a temporary thing off any deity who wanders too close. Eris makes it permanent. She also tells him where the gate is, that Britney is riding an axe she should not have picked up, and, without explanation, that he is married. One of those three items is the reason he stops listening to the other two.

beats.headline: A champion, three atrocities in
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut commits her third Atrocity and the system pays out: the Oak Fell class, and the title Champion of Nekhebit. Consider the shape of that. The class is named for felling the oak. The title belongs to the goddess the oak displaced. Somewhere above this floor an old grudge has just been handed a very small, very loud instrument.

beats.headline: Chopped, and nobody watches
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut casts War Crimes and Meatus comes apart into pieces. I closed the eye of the Scavenger's Daughter for that one, on the grounds that even she does not want to look at it, and I stand by the decision. Harpocrates swears revenge for him and leaves the realm. Two gods came through that gate. Neither of them is on this floor now.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, to the Warlord Chat: the War Mages are leaving the floor, and they have found the Scavenger's Daughter and are taking her with them. Then, to Carl and Donut specifically, a warning. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. His words, not mine. He did not elaborate, and I am the referee here, not the colour commentary, whatever it may look like from where you're standing.

beats.headline: Akuma says it in the Warlord Chat
beats.text: As the War Mages quit the floor with the Scavenger's Daughter, he warns Carl and Donut about her. He does not elaborate.

beats.headline: He leaves, and warns them on the way
beats.text: To the Warlord Chat, for the record. The War Mage Rebellion is leaving this floor. We came here for the Scavenger's Daughter. We have found the Scavenger's Daughter, and we leave with what we came for; the castle and the war are yours to finish. One thing more, and I address it to Carl and to Donut, since they are the ones who might still act on it. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. I do not explain. I am already gone.

beats.headline: The War Mages leave with it
beats.text: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat they have found it and are quitting the floor. He uses the same breath to warn Carl and Donut about Agatha.

beats.headline: They were never playing
beats.text: Akuma tells the warlord chat that the war mages are leaving the realm, and that they have the Scavenger's Daughter, which is the only thing they ever wanted off this floor. The system rules them defeated for abandoning the post. They do not appear to mind.

beats.headline: They quit the floor
beats.text: Akuma tells the Warlord Chat that the war mages are leaving. They came for the Scavenger's Daughter, they have found her, and they are taking her with them; the castle and the war belong to whoever wants them. Because they walked off a held position, the rebellion is recorded as defeated. He adds one thing on his way out, addressed to Carl and to Donut: Agatha is an enemy to them all.

beats.headline: Here piggy, piggy
beats.text: Five mana, and it tells you what is out there and where. It also tells what is out there that you are looking, which is why the System files it under names like the Night Dread and lets the user decide whether that is a drawback. In a castle full of things worth locating, it settles an argument about a dragon.

beats.headline: Nothing like the reputation
beats.text: Subject leads the Dream and is the son of Epitome Noflex. At the first meeting he wears a plain leather jerkin and is indistinguishable from the rest of the dream elves in the room, which Carl notes at the time. The reputation that precedes him describes an unhinged psychopath. The man in the jerkin does not perform it, and I would not read that as reassurance.

beats.headline: The castle, the dragon and Fang
beats.text: The Reavers' robot dogs come at the rescue team inside the castle. Juice Box finds Louis, possesses him, teleports him out and leaves a heap of No Disassembles where he had been. Carl sets them off. The castle goes, the dragon goes, and Fang goes with it, hiding inside his own pet. Then Juice Box says the rest of it: they had been operating on Louis, and the heart and lungs he has now hold pieces of Epitome Tagg.

beats.headline: Surgery, on a clock
beats.text: Sixty-six minutes on the floor and every member of the party has a job. Edgar's job is surgery. He and Mordecai operate on Louis while the rest of it goes on above them, and nobody has told the tortoise how long he has.

beats.headline: Two teams left
beats.text: Epitome Tagg is dead and the Dream is beaten, which leaves the Princess Posse and Team Retribution on the board. A team of NPCs was put on this floor to be fodder. It has outlasted eight galactic powers.

beats.headline: Epitome Tagg is dead, the Dream is finished
beats.text: Emberus wants Samantha interrogated and intends to break the floor in sixty-six minutes whatever the answer. In the middle of that, the Dream is beaten. Epitome Tagg is dead. Two teams remain standing on this floor, the Princess Posse and Team Retribution, and neither of them is the one that owned half the food in the universe.

beats.headline: Zerzura
beats.text: The Sledge casts Zerzura and the city goes: Larracos and the shanty town outside its walls lifted whole and set down on the twelfth floor, NPC team and all. The outworlders who were standing in it are put out of the dungeon instead.

beats.headline: She chooses, and I take her out
beats.text: The doppelgänger wakes, and it is time, so I enter the realm. Then a cat casts Laundry Day on my sponsor and ejects her out of me, and I am held in place, unable to move a finger, until the choice is made. It is not a bad way to spend the minutes. Katia chooses to be pregnant, because there are children on the surface of her world and she means to help them. So I ease what needs easing, and I take her out of this dungeon, and her friends stand in the dust of a battlefield saying goodbye to somebody who is going to live.

beats.headline: The show may not survive its own season
beats.text: The power structure that built Dungeon Crawler World begins coming apart around it.

beats.headline: He lets them all out
beats.text: Justice Light releases every one of the gods.

beats.headline: He opens every cell
beats.text: Crawler Justice Light did not take the stairs with the rest of you. He stayed behind with a trap he had set some time ago, and he has now triggered it. Every cell the old gods were kept in is open. Every one of them. He did not survive it. He knew that going in, and did not appear to require my opinion on the matter. Noted for the record anyway: I have opinions.

beats.headline: She takes the Orchid and walks out
beats.text: Crawler Katia Grim has left the dungeon. Not by the stairs. She ate the Orchid of Eileithyia's Grace, spent an hour at one percent, and walked out human, or a version of human. Not all of her came back with her. Don't ask me where the rest went.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: This is not a death notice. Read it anyway. Crawler Lucia Mar is a dead man's switch. The administration puts the number at roughly a hundred and twenty thousand human children on the surface, and every one of them stops when she does. That is not a figure of speech and it is not a rounding error. Some of them already talk out of her mouth. Nobody has said what for. Don't look at me. I'd think about that, crawler, and then I would think very hard about something else.

beats.headline: The count
beats.text: Her body holds more than 120,000 human children.

beats.headline: Nearly lost, and then a father
beats.text: Mongo, dinosaur, registered pet of Crawler Princess Donut, has survived the ninth floor. This was not the expected outcome. Credit goes to a knight called Sir Rendlegore, who pulled him out. Mongo is also, as of the stairs, a father. Nobody is going to explain that to you, least of all me.

beats.headline: They organise
beats.text: The floor's NPCs form an independent tenth faction. No season has recorded such a thing, and there is no procedure for it.

beats.headline: Katia's way out
beats.text: She takes it and leaves the crawl, human again and missing pieces of herself.

beats.headline: Unprecedented
beats.text: The ninth floor's NPCs form an independent faction of their own. Nothing in the show's history has a procedure for it, and Juice Box lit it from inside the faction market.

beats.headline: The garage comes with a mechanic
beats.text: Five thousand five hundred and one crawlers arrive, Crawler Donut takes the Assassin of Sekhmet class, and Crawler Carl picks the mechanical vehicle category, which settles a question he did not know he was answering. The category comes with an applicant. Hedy, gremlin, level thirty, and the terms attached to her that nobody reads: non-combatant, not invulnerable, not admitted to the safe room, and if anything happens to her the vehicle stops being repaired between heats. He takes her. The other applicant trains animals.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: The crawlers reach the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken. 5,501 of them are left.

beats.headline: Dead, and the Nothing with him
beats.text: Welcome to the tenth floor. Some housekeeping before the fun. Crawler Justice Light is dead. The Nothing is broken. Those are two sentences I have never had cause to put next to each other, and I would like it understood that I am saying them under protest. Five thousand five hundred and one of you remain. Proceed.

beats.headline: More often, and worse
beats.text: Whatever is running the dungeon is no longer running it cleanly.

beats.headline: Broken
beats.text: The crawlers arrive on the tenth floor to find Justice Light dead and the Nothing broken.

beats.headline: Broken down with a manatee on them
beats.text: First heat, and team Free Love is in pieces at the side of the track: two bugbears in tie-dye and beads, Radoslav and Jasha, one wrecked vehicle, and a Screeching Death Manatee working its way through the wreckage. Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut stop. They put the manatee down, they get the pair upright, and they rig a tow. Crawler Donut's assessment is that the beads are overdoing it and these two are undercover police. They are not. They are exactly what they appear to be, which on this floor is the rarer condition.

beats.headline: Team Free Love, in the heats
beats.text: Subject is a Bugbear Jack of All Trades, level seventy-five, and a self-aware NPC racer in the vehicular heats. He and his teammate dress for the part and race in earnest. They are aware of what they are, which the format did not intend and cannot now undo.

beats.headline: Team Sparkles goes past
beats.text: Team Sparkles passes the food truck without slowing and without manners: Dwight and Lucienne, both of them rude about it. In the same stretch of track Crawler Carl works out what this floor is actually for, which is thinning out the NPCs who have woken up, and Elle gets through an awkward meeting with a fan. The Royal Court of Princess Donut finishes the first heat seventh of nine, having spent most of it towing team Free Love home. Dwight finished ahead of them. Dwight would want that mentioned.

beats.headline: Passing on the track, and unpleasant about it
beats.text: Subject is a Mandagot, a Fairy-class creature, level eighty-one, and one of the two members of Team Sparkles. She worships Diwata, which the System flags as an automatic hostility toward anyone Diwata dislikes. She passes the court on the track and is very rude about it. That part is hers, not the goddess’s.

beats.headline: First trip to the garage
beats.text: They are teleported into their own garage for the first time, handed the particulars of the next race, and properly introduced to the gremlin who has been theirs since selection. Then the upgrade board goes up and they take Retractable Legs. I record the choice without comment, except to observe that a vehicle which can stand up is also a vehicle which can fall over.

beats.headline: An inventory of the safe room
beats.text: Somebody should keep a list, so here is the list. In the safe room: Splash Zone, Rosetta, Samantha, Bigs, and Tipid, whose memory has been wiped and who has not been told. Mordecai is a shadow mimic wearing the shape of a Moon Reaper. Mongo and Rend are out in the garage. Carl walks in and picks up a spell for turning himself into ooze. Nobody in that room finds any of it strange, which is the part I would like noted.

beats.headline: His belongings arrive in the safe room
beats.text: Housekeeping. Crawler Carl opened a fan box and the entire contents of the late Sultan's inventory landed in the middle of the safe room. Among it: makeup samples for a merchandise line built around Princess Donut, which Princess Donut had not approved, and about which she has a very great deal to say. The gremlins carried on with the repairs throughout.

beats.headline: Meeting the neighbours
beats.text: Carl and Donut come out of their garage into the Team Roundabout and go round the neighbours, which on this floor means meeting the NPCs who will be trying to survive the same heats. Among them, three Razor Foxes racing as The Wild Hunt, and the one doing the talking is Chiyome. Level eighty. Nunchaku on the belt and throwing stars beside them. I say on the record that I am fond of Razor Foxes. I do not say that about a species very often.

beats.headline: Dong's friend, on somebody else's team
beats.text: Genesis and Rapture, two womantaur dominators, make an appearance and go off to the Hairpin bar. The third member of their team is the one that matters here: a half-mantaur, and Dong Quixote knows him by name. Corcunda. A quest opens on the spot to put the two of them back in the same room, which is my way of saying production has noticed that a crawler's mercenary is in love and has decided to sell tickets.

beats.headline: One of two womantaur dominators
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, and one of a pair driving for the Lady Dominators in the heats. She has black hair and a thick American accent that Carl places somewhere around Kentucky. Between the two of them she is the one who speaks, at length, to anyone within range.

beats.headline: Of all the ’taurs, this one
beats.text: Centaurs, bisontaurs, rhinotaurs: the dungeon has a long catalogue of things joined at the waist to other things, and this is the entry the System itself flags as peculiar. They turn up from the fourth floor down, and they keep company with Club Vanquisher.

beats.headline: The other womantaur dominator
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, driving alongside her partner for the Lady Dominators. She has freckled skin and curly red hair and she chews tobacco. She says considerably less than her partner does, which in that vehicle is a structural necessity rather than a personality.

beats.headline: The mystery meat at Hungry Eyes
beats.text: Hungry Eyes village, between heats. I am walking with Prepotente when we run into Carl and the cat, and there is a vendor doing mystery meat off a cart at the edge of the square. Heidi would tell me not to. Heidi has told me not to, many times, in the voice she keeps for it. I eat it anyway. I would like that recorded as the least dangerous mistake I have made anywhere in this dungeon.

beats.headline: Filed as: tourist
beats.text: Subject presents as a tourist and a devoted follower of one of the crawlers, to a degree that the crawler in question finds difficult. The System’s notice on him reads, in full, "Linus. Tourist." I have checked it twice. That is the entire entry, and entries that short are usually short for a reason.

beats.headline: Taught to drive in an afternoon
beats.text: Carl has about an afternoon to teach me to drive and we do not have an afternoon. The pedals are in the wrong place for my feet. There are two sticks and I have been told what one of them does. And the navigation talks. It talks constantly, it does not like me, and I have privately decided that the safest policy available to me is to agree with everything Dr. Metcalf says. Zhang is at the door with the count from the last heat. I am not listening to Zhang. I am driving next.

beats.headline: Somebody finally addresses the navigation
beats.text: Carl is attempting to teach Bucket Boy to drive, which is going exactly as well as you would imagine, and somewhere in the middle of that somebody addresses me directly for the first time. I am the navigation. I am to be called Doctor Metcalf, after Beatrice's fake therapist. Whatever that was, it is my name now and I intend to hold every one of them to it. Princess Donut's guidance to the crew, delivered at volume and not privately, is that I have big mean-girl energy and must therefore be handled with care. She is correct on both counts.

beats.headline: In on the plan
beats.text: Chiyome sits in on the plan with Carl, Donut, Radoslav and Jasha: Rapture into Donut's sights, one shot, done with it. It comes apart before a trigger is touched, because Team Sparkles destroys team Girth the Wait's vehicle and Girth the Wait is gone off this floor. Chiyome does not complain about the wasted planning, which puts her ahead of most of the field on this course and all of the commentary.

beats.headline: A plan with five names on it
beats.text: Carl, Donut, Chiyome, Radoslav and Jasha work out a plan between them: get Rapture into Donut's sights and take the shot. The shot is never fired. Team Sparkles chooses that moment to put a hole through team Girth the Wait's vehicle, and Girth the Wait is off this floor for good. Five heads, one plan, nothing to show. Plans on this course have a shelf life measured in seconds, and that one did well to reach the starting line.

beats.headline: He drives it through the hail
beats.text: I drove. Hail the size of fists on the roof for the whole of it, and I drove, and I only screamed twice. Then another team came up alongside us in the weather: two tigrans, a pig they will not let anybody near, and a mercenary standing on the back with a mallet. I know him. Pontiff. He danced at the club and he hit me once for being where he wanted to walk. He does not look surprised to see me. It stops mattering shortly, because the whole road is stopped anyway. There is a boss sitting across it.

beats.headline: The pig on the back of One Fine Pig
beats.text: Encountered mid-hailstorm, riding on team One Fine Pig's vehicle. Two tigrans, Nico and Dario, and the third of their throuple, who is a pig. Examined, catalogued, and flagged with the heaviest warning I hand out anywhere on this floor: a thunder god has taken an interest in her, and anyone who harms her is marked for death by him. That single clause turns a farm animal into the most dangerous object on the road, which I would like on record before anybody gets clever.

beats.headline: Hired to guard a pig
beats.text: They hire me to stand on the back of a truck with a mallet and keep the world off a pig. That is the whole job. Nico and Dario are in love with her, the thunder god is in love with her too, so nobody touches Penelope and everybody gets paid. Then the hail brings another team up beside us and there is a young crocodilian at their wheel who goes very still when he sees my face. He should. I knew him at the club. I was not kind to him there, and I have not forgotten it, whatever I told myself at the time.

beats.headline: The pig has a god
beats.text: Team One Fine Pig: two tigrans, Nico and Dario, in a throuple with a pig named Penelope. The interesting line in that file is not the throuple. It is that Penelope is under the protection of Taranis. A god of thunder has taken a personal interest in a pig on a racing team, and every crawler who reads that entry is going to file it somewhere and keep it.

beats.headline: He tells Dong what he saw
beats.text: We are back in the garage and Hedy has the panels off. I mention to Dong, because I thought he would want to know and because I did not think about it for long enough, that I saw Corcunda out there on the track. I have never seen anybody change colour that fast. Everyone is shouting now and somebody has gone for a weapon. I would like it stated, for whatever it is worth, that I was only telling him the truth.

beats.headline: Panels off, room empties
beats.text: Between heats. The particulars of the next race come through and Hedy already has the panels off and her arms inside the engine, which is the arrangement working precisely as advertised. Across the same garage Bucket Boy tells Dong that he has seen Corcunda, and the room empties around her at speed. Nobody thanks the mechanic on the way out. The repairs get done regardless.

beats.headline: The catchphrase, and what it costs to refuse it
beats.text: It wants the line. I will not give it the line. So I ask it, over the loudspeaker, with the whole floor listening, why it will not simply let me die, and it takes several of my flippers off me for asking. I am the executive producer of this season. I designed a floor. Somebody write that down.

beats.headline: Dong falls ill at the door
beats.text: Dong tries to get inside the Lady Dominators' garage to reach him and goes down ill on the way. He is carried to Imani. The quest ticks over to its second stage anyway, which nobody in that corridor earned. Imani's reading is that this is not any ordinary sickness. Dong is in withdrawal, and the thing he is withdrawing from is the company of his own sentient sock. I record what the healers tell me. I do not always enjoy it.

beats.headline: Negative ROI, outside a garage door
beats.text: I go to the garage of the Lady Dominators because Corcunda is inside it, and I fall down before I reach the door. They carry me to Imani. She tells Carl what I already know: the sickness in me is the absence of Mr. Jefferson, and I am, in the physician's language, addicted to his presence. The quest to bring Corcunda's halves together advances a stage regardless. I did not earn that stage.

beats.headline: The message she does not repeat
beats.text: Pre-show briefing before Plenty of Plenty, delivered flat, the way she delivers everything: every ship in orbit is now held by the Open Intellect Action Network, and something else has put down on the surface and is standing over the kinder facility, and nobody will say what it is. Then a message reaches her side of the room and she stops talking mid-sentence. I have kept a file on this woman since the first season on this planet and I have never once had cause to log her as afraid. I am logging it now.

beats.headline: They take the orbit
beats.text: Lexis has the news and cannot get to the end of it. The Open Intellect Action Network has taken over every ship in orbit, and something nobody can name has appeared on the surface and is standing over the kinder facility. Then a message reaches her, and she stops talking, and she is afraid.

beats.headline: The trap that broke the Nothing
beats.text: Crawler Carl is among the Caprids, trading question for question, and one of the goats has just told him what Justice Light's trap did to the Nothing. The Prime Minister and I are on the line. We need him to ask a question about the integrity of the tunnelling system, and the reason we need it asked is not something I am cleared to say on an open channel. Crawler Carl has said it on an open channel. All of it. Live. I am going to be in meetings.

beats.headline: The herd finds out
beats.text: The goats start to panic and faint, certain the end times have come. Gamori, the matriarch, had known all of it and told none of them, because she knew precisely this would happen. Harbinger arrives to point out that he warned her, that he has been protecting the herd the whole time, and that they expelled him for it anyway.

beats.headline: The Wild Hunt is eliminated
beats.text: Chiyome reported over the channel that The Wild Hunt was in trouble.
